tokens.title: Template tokens
tokens.text:
{name} original name (no extension)
{current} name after the previous rules
{ext} original extension
{parent} folder name
{size} size in bytes
{n} counter · {n:03} with 3 digits
{letter} A, B… AA · {letter:lower} a, b…
{date:%Y-%m-%d} modified date
{created:%Y} created date
{exif:%Y-%m-%d_%H%M} date the photo was taken
{now:%Y-%m-%d} today's date
{artist} {title} {album} {track:02} {year} {genre} music tags
date_format.help: %Y year · %m month · %d day · %H hour · %M minute · %S second · %B month name
field.trim: Trim spaces and separators at the ends
tip.find: With regex, use groups ( ) and reference them with \1, \2… in “Replace with”.
tip.position_insert: How many characters come before the inserted text (0 = at the start).
tip.start_remove: Position of the first character to remove (1 = first).
choice.name: Name (without extension)
choice.title: Title (Each Word)
issue.path_traversal: Name not allowed (would leave the folder).
issue.path_separator: The name cannot contain / or \ (it would move the file to another folder).
issue.control_chars: The name contains invisible control characters.
issue.reserved_name: “{name}” is a reserved name on Windows.
issue.trailing_dot_space: The name cannot end with a dot or space.
issue.leading_space: The name starts with a space.
issue.becomes_hidden: The file will become hidden (name starts with a dot).
issue.path_too_long: Path longer than {max} characters; some Windows programs may fail to open it.
issue.ext_removed: The extension will be removed; the file may not open with the right program.
issue.ext_changed: The extension will change; this does not convert the file.
issue.conflict_duplicate: Another item would also be named “{name}”.
issue.case_conflict_portable: Differs from another name only by case; it would clash on Windows/macOS.
issue.exif_missing: No EXIF date; using the modified date.
issue.pillow_missing: Pillow not installed; using the modified date.
issue.mutagen_missing: mutagen not installed; music tags unavailable.
err.folder_unreadable: No permission to read the folder: {path}
err.target_exists: A file with the target name appeared after the preview: {path}
err.source_missing: The file no longer exists (moved or deleted?): {path}
cli.description: RenameThis! — batch rename files with preview, validation and undo.
cli.epilog: Example: renamethis-cli rename ./photos --sort modified --add counter padding=3 position=prefix separator=" - " --dry-run
cli.help.rename: Rename the files in a folder.
cli.help.recover: Restore names from an interrupted operation.
